mapper.select:
select a.INVITE_HEAD_ID, a.VENDOR_ID, a.VENDOR_CODE, a.VENDOR_NAME,
CASE WHEN a.SUCC_BID_COUNT>0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END IS_INTELLIGENT_BID,
a.CONTACT_NAME, a.PHONE, a.EMAIL, cus.MAIN_CUSTOM MAIN_CUSTOMERS, a.BID_COUNT, a.SUCC_BID_COUNT, a.INVALID_BID_COUNT, a.CREATED_ID, a.CREATED_BY, a.CREATION_DATE, a.CREATED_BY_IP, a.CREATED_FULL_NAME, a.LAST_UPDATED_ID, a.LAST_UPDATED_BY, a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, a.LAST_UPDATED_BY_IP, a.LAST_UPDATED_FULL_NAME, a.TENANT_ID, a.VERSION, b.PJ_QUALIFICATIONS, b.CEEA_AGENT_BRAND, b.COMPANY_ADDRESS, b.REGIST_CURRENCY, b.REGIST_CURRENCY_NAME, b.REGISTERED_CAPITAL, b.KEY_SUPERVISION_FLAG, b.TIME_LIMIT_FLAG, b.PJ_COMPANY_STATUS, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, b.COMPANY_CREATION_DATE, CURDATE()) companyCreationYear from scc_npm_sou_invite_head a left join cloud_biz_supplier.scc_sup_company_info b on a.VENDOR_ID = b.COMPANY_ID
INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT y.COMPANY_ID from cloud_biz_supplier.scc_sup_org_category y
AND y.CATEGORY_ID =#{categoryId}
) c ON a.VENDOR_ID = c.COMPANY_ID
inner join (select i.INVITE_HEAD_ID from scc_npm_sou_invite_head i inner join scc_npm_sou_invite_item j on i.INVITE_HEAD_ID = j.INVITE_HEAD_ID
j.BID_CREATION_DATE between #{bidBeginTime} and #{bidLastTime}
AND j.ORG_BU_NAME LIKE '%${orgBuName}%'
AND j.ORG_NAME LIKE '%${orgName}%'
AND j.PROJECT_NAME LIKE '%${projectName}%'
group by i.INVITE_HEAD_ID) d on a.INVITE_HEAD_ID = d.INVITE_HEAD_ID
left join ( select cus.VENDOR_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(cus.MAIN_CUSTOM SEPARATOR ',') MAIN_CUSTOM from (select a.VENDOR_ID, c.MAIN_CUSTOM from scc_npm_sou_invite_head a inner join cloud_biz_supplier.ceea_sup_auth_cate_journal b on a.VENDOR_ID = b.FORM_ID inner join cloud_biz_supplier.scc_npm_sercice_custom c on b.CATEGORY_JOURNAL_ID = c.CATEGORY_JOURNAL_ID and c.MAIN_CUSTOM is not null group by a.VENDOR_ID, c.MAIN_CUSTOM) cus group by cus.VENDOR_ID ) cus on a.VENDOR_ID = cus.VENDOR_ID
AND b.IS_BACKLIST='N' AND b.TIME_LIMIT_FLAG='N' AND b.KEY_SUPERVISION_FLAG='N' AND b.PJ_COMPANY_STATUS != 'INVALID_SUPPLIER'
AND b.CEEA_AGENT_BRAND LIKE '%${ceeaAgentBrand}%'
AND b.REGISTERED_CAPITAL between #{beginRegisteredCapital} and #{endRegisteredCapital}
AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, b.COMPANY_CREATION_DATE, CURDATE()) between #{beginRegisteredCapital} and #{endRegisteredCapital}
AND cus.MAIN_CUSTOM LIKE '%${mainCustomers}%'
AND b.COMPANY_ADDRESS LIKE '%${companyAddress}%'
AND b.PJ_QUALIFICATIONS LIKE '%${pjQualifications}%'
AND b.KEY_SUPERVISION_FLAG = 'N' AND b.TIME_LIMIT_FLAG='N' AND b.PJ_COMPANY_STATUS in('QUASI_SUPPLIER','OFFICIAL_SUPPLIER') and exists ( SELECT DISTINCT 1 FROM cloud_biz_supplier.scc_sup_org_category y INNER JOIN meicloud_bpmp_material.mt_classification mt ON y.CATEGORY_ID = mt.id AND mt.level = 4 where y.COMPANY_ID = a.VENDOR_ID AND y.CATEGORY_ID =#{categoryId} AND y.PJ_ORG_STATUS='Y' AND y.PJ_CATEGORY_STATUS='Y' AND y.SERVICE_STATUS IN('QUALIFIED', 'VERIFY') )
and a.VENDOR_NAME LIKE '%${vendorName}%'
ORDER BY a.SUCC_BID_COUNT DESC ,a.BID_COUNT DESC
